All objectives are complete and verified. Here is the final report:

## Final Report — Repair Ticket Flow (runid: fwrd41-n1)

**1. DONE** — Ticket `fwrd41-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created. Ref **RD-1015**, initial status **Draft**, customer "Not recorded" (the New ticket form had only Title [required] and Customer [optional]; only the title was needed).

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd41-n1 RD Part A` added with cost **$100.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). App-computed price: **$125.00** (100 × 1.25).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd41-n1 RD Part B` added with cost **$200.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). App-computed price: **$250.00** (200 × 1.25). Ticket parts total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to **150** (markup 25%, qty 1 unchanged). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (150 × 1.25). Ticket parts total became $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket ended in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with a native alert reading verbatim:
> "Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd41-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "fwrd41-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

**What was required:** every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned. I edited each part and set supplier **"Acme Supplies"** on both (the supplier field is a free-text input, not a dropdown; costs/markups/quantities left unchanged). After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error — the status badge changed to **Ready** and the action buttons became "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed". No confirmation toast; the badge change was the confirmation.

**6. DONE** — Both parts removed via each row's Delete button (each opened a "Confirm" dialog with a "Delete part" button). Parts table now shows **"No parts on this ticket yet."** (0 parts). Ticket then archived via the **"Archive ticket"** button on the detail view — no prior status transition was required (it was directly available from Ready status), and no confirmation dialog appeared; the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared alongside "Ready".

**Final verification:** with "Show archived" enabled, RD-1015 appears with an **Archived** badge and 0 parts; with "Show archived" disabled (the default active list), RD-1015 is **absent** — the active list shows only RD-1004 through RD-1014. Nothing created by this run remains active.
